title: Hanuman and the mountain of herbs.
lines: This is a story from India, about the strong monkey Hanuman.
Hanuman was a monkey with a big heart.
He was stronger than a hundred elephants.
He could fly as fast as the wind.
And he could grow bigger and smaller, just as he wanted.
Hanuman was Prince Rama's best friend and helper.
Rama was fighting the wicked giant Ravana, on the island of Lanka.
Because Ravana had taken Sita prisoner, Rama's wife.
One day, in a big battle, Lakshmana was hit by an arrow.
He didn't open his eyes anymore.
Rama knelt down next to his brother.
My brother, my dear brother, he said.
All the monkeys and bears stood there quietly.
They didn't know what to do.
He looked at Lakshmana very carefully.
There's only one thing that can save him, he said.
Far away, in the north, in the high Himalayas, there is a mountain.
On that mountain grows a special herb.
It glows in the dark, like a little lamp.
If Lakshmana gets that herb, he will get better.
But it must be before the sun comes up.
Otherwise it will be too late.
The Himalayas are very far away!
Who can get there and back in one night?
Rama put his hand on Hanuman's head.
He pushed off with his strong legs.
Over rivers and forests and villages.
The wind whistled past his ears.
At last he saw the Himalayas.
High, white mountains with snow on top.
He looked for the glowing herb.
There were so many plants and herbs, and they all glowed a little.
But the night was passing quickly.
If I don't know which herb it is, he thought, I'll just take the whole mountain with me!
He grabbed the mountain with his two strong arms.
He pulled the whole mountain out of the ground.
He lifted it up with one hand, like a waiter holding a tray.
With the whole mountain above his head.
The people in the villages looked up.
Hanuman flew over the land, over the sea.
In the east the sky was already turning a little pink.
Just in time he landed next to Rama.
The old doctor ran to the mountain.
He knew straight away which herb it was.
He made a drink from it.
And at that very moment the sun came up.
The first rays of sunshine fell on Lakshmana's face.
The monkeys jumped up and down.
Hanuman, he said, you are the most loyal friend in the world.
And that's why, whenever you see a picture of Hanuman, you often see him with a mountain in his hand.
To show that a true friend will do anything to help.
